# Curie

> Open-source, self-hostable platform that turns supported agents into co-workers in team workspaces. Start with Software Factory: delegate a GitHub issue and inspect a reviewed pull request or a clear failure reason. Bring supported existing skills and tools onto the same platform.

The CLI can be driven by a coding agent or a developer. Use released installation
paths for adoption; contributor builds are a separate journey. Read capability
status before promising a channel, model runtime, memory behavior, or control.

- [README.md](README.md): product identity and three developer adoption paths.

## The parity ladder (skill -> local -> cluster)

The runner-only skill target, full local Compose platform, and Kubernetes cluster
use the same bundle format. Environment checks help catch deployment differences;
they do not guarantee identical model behavior in production.

- [README.md#quickstart](README.md#quickstart): local-to-cluster walkthrough.
- [README.md#which-target-do-i-want](README.md#which-target-do-i-want): target selection.
- [cli/README.md](cli/README.md): full command/flag reference.
- [docs/slack-local-runbook.md](docs/slack-local-runbook.md): local Slack test path.
- [docs/release-verification.md](docs/release-verification.md): release asset verification.
